source: Avant Music News
excerpt: Ava Mendoza is simply one of the best guitarists around today. She has played with a murderer's row of improvisers and experimentalists over the last 20 years, across styles incorporating rock, blues, jazz, bluegrass, metal, and the avant-garde. Alive Alone, Alive Together collects Mendoza's recent live recordings from four different events.

source: Avant Music News
excerpt: Human attention is a variable. Some of us hold focus more easily than others. Some individuals can direct their attention to virtually any target, while others struggle to attend to anything not of interest. On Cartographies of the Unseen, Vyormouth explores hidden, buried, or abandoned places in frozen settings, and asks something different of the listener.
